
A '''syllable''' consists of an '''onset''', a non-[[Morphology: vowels]]  '''nucleus''', and a '''coda'''. ''(A y-nucleus is excluded from the definition of '''syllable''' just for convenience, because y-syllables are not allowed in [[Morphology: f|fu'ivla]]. y-syllables in [[Morphology: brivla|brivla]] always have an empty '''coda'''.)''

An '''onset''' is an [[Morphology: consonants|initial]] consonant or cluster, or a [[Morphology: vowels|glide]], or an [[Morphology: consonants]], or empty. ''(An empty onset can only appear at the beginning of a word, an h onset can never appear at the beginning of a word, a glide onset can never appear immediately after a diphthong.)'' 

A '''nucleus''' is a [[Morphology: vowels|diphthong]], or a [[Morphology: vowels|vowel]], or a [[Morphology: vowels]], not followed directly by another '''nucleus'''.

A '''coda''' is a single [[Morphology: consonants|consonant]], or empty, not the start of a '''consonantal-syllable''', nor of an [[Morphology: consonants|initial]] consonant or cluster.

A '''consonantal-syllable''' consists of a [[Morphology: consonants|consonant]] and a [[Morphology: consonants|syllabic]] consonant, and must always be followed by another '''consonantal-syllable''' or by an [[Morphology: consonants|initial]] consonant or cluster. 

A '''final-syllable''' (of a [[Morphology: brivla|brivla]]) is a '''syllable''' whose nucleus is not '''stressed''', followed directly by a [[Morphology: special characters|pause]] or by a [[Morphology: words|Lojban-word]] other than a [[Morphology: cmene|cmene]].

A '''stressed-syllable''', a '''stressed-diphthong''' and a '''stressed-vowel''' are, respectively, a '''syllable''', a [[Morphology: vowels|diphthong]] and a [[Morphology: vowels|vowel]] with where the vowel is '''stressed''' ('A', 'E', 'I', 'O', 'U') or with '''stress''' being marked by being followed (possibly after intervening y and/or consonantal syllables) by just one '''syllable''' and then by a [[Morphology: special characters|pause]]. ''(The use of capital 'I' and 'U' in [[Morphology: vowels|glide]] position, or capital consonants, is not taken as a mark of stress.)''

An '''unstressed-syllable''', an '''unstressed-diphthong''' and an '''unstressed-vowel''' are, respectively, a '''syllable''', a [[Morphology: vowels|diphthong]] and a [[Morphology: vowels|vowel]] not '''stressed''' as described above.
